sourceState: Historical revision 1 extracted the Workflow authoring wire and capability admission boundary. Revision 3 retains that wire contract while maintained WorkflowContracts.cs and WorkflowSupport.cs borrow the shared Text and Serialization declarations inside the existing Contracts artifacts. The immutable authority resolver and human-gated CP firing fence remain; this provenance composition claims no new interpreter or runtime qualification. Revision 4 (T-488/platform-model-parity) adds the optional envelope, requiredStandings and the sealed sys.roles vocabulary to the wire and to both admission mirrors; the engine model runs the same fixtures.
